correctness.rationale: For Carmichael n, Korselt guarantees squarefree odd n. Write d_min for the least divisor with d*lcm_{p|d}(p−1)>n and p1>p2>... its descending prime factors. For j≥2, removing p_j from n leaves p1, giving lambda(n/p_j)≥p1−1>p_j because distinct odd primes differ by at least 2; hence n/p_j is stopping, so d_min≤n/p_j. But d_min≥p1...p_j>p_j^j, yielding p_j^(j+1)<n. The result is universal, not a finite exhaustive extrapolation. Independent integer enumeration of 16 Carmichael numbers through 100000 tested 18 depth inequalities and critical printed B=10^24 cutoffs.
